_readme: Judged pairs of a /list legal name and a portfolio-grid slug where the registered name does not contain the brand (Maplebear is Instacart). Applied by scratch/pull-compliance-list.py after the automatic joins. Each pair is a company the judge recognised by name and domain (2026-09-27, PRO-166); a pair that is a guess is not here. Where a grid name has two candidate legal names and only one fits the grid page's domain, the fitting one is taken; the other stays its own row.
_held_back: Pairs NOT taken for want of a fit: latent-health / latent-space vs 'Latent, Inc.' (two grid rows, one legal name); trellis, step, visor, array, mesh, lens-protocol (candidate names share only a word). Re:Build Manufacturing, LP and Circle's Arc Token line are the same companies' second vehicles and are merged by identity-merges.json at the build, not here. Also held back 2026-09-27: Grove Labs (an indoor-garden company, not grovemedical.com), Upside Services (upside.com changed hands), Ponto Software (a roll-up vehicle of the same name exists), Sora ID (the grid slug and domain disagree).
